tools.name: list_paid_products
tools.description: List all InstaVeil x402 products with current prices, resource URLs, input schemas and examples.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one InstaVeil x402 product in decision-ready form before an agent spends USDC.

tools.name: get_purchase_instructions
tools.description: Return exact machine purchase steps for one InstaVeil product using x402 V2 and Solana USDC.

tools.name: recommend_paid_product
tools.description: Recommend the lowest-friction InstaVeil paid x402 product for an agent task, with exact price and resource URL.

tools.name: build_purchase_request
tools.description: Build a ready-to-send InstaVeil x402 POST request for one paid product so an autonomous agent can purchase with minimal integration work.

tools.name: get_discovery_urls
tools.description: Return canonical machine-readable URLs for InstaVeil x402, OpenAPI, llms.txt and human fallback.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_paid_products, get_discovery_urls · Public sink: build_purchase_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_paid_products, get_discovery_urls · Public sink: build_purchase_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
